info.longName: Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight Health Care ETF

funds_data.description: The underlying index, which is composed of securities of all companies included in the S&P 500® Index that are classified as members of the health care sector, as defined according to the Global Industry Classification Standard (“GICS®”). The fund generally invests in all of the securities comprising the underlying index in proportion to their weightings in the underlying index.
